'''Ryvester''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kosh Teradoc]] was presumed [[Death/Legends|dead]] on the planet during a [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, [[Mission to Ryvester|mission]]<ref name="MK" /> in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the main events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]]. This event occurred during a flashback set in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> Teradoc kept a personal [[Teradoc's yacht|yacht]] in the bay to the east of his [[Imperial Navy base (Ryvester)|naval base]] which the Wraiths stole after their mission.<ref name="MK" />
